article.title: Hutchinson finding happiness after emotional turmoil
article.summary: Willy Hutchinson tells BBC Scotland about how he struggles with regulating his emotions after a fight night as he prepares to face Joshua Buatsi for the vacant WBC light-heavyweight title.
